translations.zh-Hant: 跟著裝置語言；簡體中文改用繁體中文，其他沒有譯文的語言用英文
translations.en: Follows your device language: Traditional Chinese for Simplified Chinese, English for other languages without a translation

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀回語言設定，請重新選擇。
translations.en: Could not verify the saved language. Please select it again.

translations.zh-Hant: 記憶資料暫時無法讀取，原檔保留且不會被覆寫。請解鎖後重試。
translations.en: Memory data can’t be read right now. The original file is kept and won’t be overwritten. Unlock the device and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 個人檔案已儲存，下一次對話任務開始時生效。
translations.en: Profile saved. It applies from your next conversation task.

translations.zh-Hant: 已批准這條操作偏好，後續任務可以參考。
translations.en: Procedure approved. Later tasks can use it.

translations.zh-Hant: 已拒絕這條操作偏好；有可用撤銷紀錄時恢復修改前內容。
translations.en: Procedure declined. If there’s an undo record, the earlier content is restored.

translations.zh-Hant: 已清除個人檔案、記憶、技能與路線，並更新加密金鑰；模型和 MCP 設定保留。
translations.en: Cleared your profile, memories, skills and routes, and renewed the encryption key. Model and MCP settings are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 資料已清除並更新加密金鑰，但舊金鑰清理未完成；請解鎖後再次執行清除。
translations.en: Data cleared and the encryption key renewed, but removing the old key didn’t finish. Unlock the device and clear again.

translations.zh-Hant: 已讀取記憶，但使用次數未能儲存；原記憶保留。
translations.en: Memory was read, but its use count couldn’t be saved. The memory is unchanged.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆已完成；目前模型連線無法確認記憶整理請求的生命週期，本次未整理。
translations.en: Reply finished. The current model connection couldn’t confirm the memory tidy-up request, so memory wasn’t tidied this time.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆已完成；學習資料已在其他位置變更，這次記憶整理未儲存。請重新讀取並確認。
translations.en: Reply finished. Learning data changed elsewhere, so this memory tidy-up wasn’t saved. Reload and check.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆已完成；學習資料正在其他位置儲存，這次記憶整理未儲存。請稍後確認。
translations.en: Reply finished. Learning data is being saved elsewhere, so this memory tidy-up wasn’t saved. Check again later.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆已完成；這次記憶整理未完成，既有資料不變。你也可以到記憶與資料手寫一條。
translations.en: Reply finished. This memory tidy-up didn’t finish and existing data is unchanged. You can also add a memory yourself in Memory & Data.

translations.zh-Hant: 網站資料未儲存；請檢查內容、來源與版本，既有資料保留。
translations.en: Website data wasn’t saved. Check the content, source and version; existing data is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料未儲存；原有技能與路線保留。
translations.en: Learning data wasn’t saved. Existing skills and routes are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 任務已停止；技能結果紀錄未能儲存，既有資料保留。
translations.en: The task stopped. The skill result record couldn’t be saved; existing data is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料正在其他位置儲存；本次未儲存，原有資料保留。請稍後再試。
translations.en: Learning data is being saved elsewhere. Nothing was saved this time and existing data is kept. Try again later.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料已在其他位置變更；本次未儲存，原有資料保留。請重新讀取並再次確認。
translations.en: Learning data changed elsewhere. Nothing was saved this time and existing data is kept. Reload and confirm again.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入單句、1–160 字元的個人檔案；不可包含換行、密碼、驗證碼或金鑰等敏感資料。
translations.en: Enter one sentence of 1–160 characters, with no line breaks and no sensitive data such as passwords, verification codes or keys.

translations.zh-Hant: 這條個人檔案已經存在。
個人檔案已達 20 條上限，請先整理。
translations.en: Your profile has reached 20 entries. Remove some first.

translations.zh-Hant: 指定片段必須只出現在一條現用檔案中，而且只出現一次；請重新選擇。
translations.en: The chosen text must appear exactly once, in a single active entry. Choose again.

translations.zh-Hant: 個人檔案狀態無效；原資料保留，變更未套用。
translations.en: The profile is in an invalid state. The original data is kept and the change wasn’t applied.

translations.zh-Hant: 密碼、驗證碼、金鑰與其他敏感資料不能存入記憶。
translations.en: Passwords, verification codes, keys and other sensitive data can’t be saved to memory.
A memory must be 1 to 200 characters.

translations.zh-Hant: 記憶已達 500 條上限，請先整理。
translations.en: Memory is full at 500 entries. Delete a few first.

translations.zh-Hant: 資料已有新變更，舊的整理結果未套用。
translations.en: The data has changed since, so the earlier tidy-up wasn’t applied.

translations.zh-Hant: 記憶變更未完成，請檢查內容後重試。
translations.en: The memory change didn’t finish. Check the content and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能引用了此版本尚未提供的工具，未匯入或啟用。
translations.en: The skill uses a tool this version doesn’t have, so it wasn’t imported or turned on.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能內含可能的敏感資料，未儲存。
translations.en: The skill may contain sensitive data, so it wasn’t saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 原技能已被修改，請重新檢查更新內容。
translations.en: The original skill has changed. Review the update again.

translations.zh-Hant: 同名技能已有待確認草稿，請先處理。
translations.en: A skill with this name already has a draft to review. Handle it first.

translations.zh-Hant: 這個名稱保留給內建技能，請使用不同的個人技能名稱。
translations.en: This name is reserved for a built-in skill. Give your skill a different name.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能須包含入口、步驟、容易出錯的地方、怎樣算辦成、什麼時候停下交給使用者五個段落。
translations.en: A skill needs five sections: where to start, the steps, what tends to go wrong, what counts as done, and when to stop and hand over to the user.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能全文超過 4,000 字上限。
translations.en: The skill text is over the 4,000-character limit.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能或版本紀錄已達儲存上限；現有資料保留，這次變更未儲存。
translations.en: Skills or their version history reached the storage limit. Existing data is kept; this change wasn’t saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能格式或狀態不符，未儲存；請檢查名稱、描述與全文。
translations.en: The skill’s format or state isn’t valid, so it wasn’t saved. Check the name, description and full text.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法儲存記憶資料，變更未套用。請解鎖裝置後重試。
translations.en: Couldn’t save memory data, so the change wasn’t applied. Unlock the device and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 刪除未儲存，原對話仍保留。請解鎖後重試。
translations.en: The deletion wasn’t saved and the conversation is still there. Unlock the device and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取加密對話，原檔保留且不會被覆寫。請解鎖後重新讀取。
translations.en: Couldn’t read the encrypted conversations. The original file is kept and won’t be overwritten. Unlock the device and reload.

translations.zh-Hant: 請提供本次要建立或修改技能的原始要求。
translations.en: Give the original request for the skill you want to create or change.

translations.zh-Hant: 引用的要求與本次使用者原話不一致，未儲存。
translations.en: The quoted request doesn’t match what you wrote this time, so nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能儲存目前無法使用。
translations.en: Skill storage isn’t available right now.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消本次技能寫作，未執行儲存。
translations.en: Skill writing was cancelled and nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 找不到指定技能，請重新查詢。
translations.en: That skill can’t be found. Search again.

translations.zh-Hant: 同名技能已存在；請先讀取全文與目前版本。
translations.en: A skill with this name exists. Read its full text and current version first.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能在讀取後已變更，請重新讀取再修改。
translations.en: The skill changed after you read it. Read it again before changing it.

translations.zh-Hant: 同名技能目前停用，請先到技能清單處理；本次不會重新啟用它。
translations.en: A disabled skill has this name. Handle it in the skill list first; this won’t turn it back on.

translations.zh-Hant: 同名技能已有待確認草稿，請先處理該草稿。
translations.en: A skill with this name has a draft to review. Handle that draft first.

translations.zh-Hant: 草稿已變更，請重新檢視並核准完整內容。
translations.en: The draft changed. Review and approve the full text again.

translations.zh-Hant: 需要核准本次完整草稿；先前的核准不能重複使用。
translations.en: This full draft needs your approval; an earlier approval can’t be reused.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次核准已逾時，請重新檢視草稿。
translations.en: This approval timed out. Review the draft again.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能資料已更新，請重新檢視本次修改。
translations.en: Skill data was updated. Review this change again.

translations.zh-Hant: 可用工具已變更，請重新檢視草稿後再核准。
translations.en: The available tools changed. Review the draft again before approving.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能未能儲存；既有資料保留，請重新檢視後再試。
translations.en: The skill couldn’t be saved. Existing data is kept; review it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次查閱已達上限，請重新開始技能寫作。
translations.en: You’ve reached this session’s lookup limit. Start writing the skill again.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能協作的執行上限設定無效。
translations.en: The skill session’s limits aren’t valid.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回傳的技能工具格式不符，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The model’s skill tool call wasn’t in the right format; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次技能協作狀態已變更，請重新開始。
translations.en: The skill session’s state changed. Start again.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先讀取本版本的技能編寫原文。
translations.en: Read this version’s skill-writing source first.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先查詢是否已有相同用途的技能。
translations.en: First search for a skill with the same purpose.

translations.zh-Hant: 只能讀取本次技能目錄或查詢結果列出的技能。
translations.en: Only skills listed in this catalog or in the search results can be read.

translations.zh-Hant: 更新版本與本次讀取的技能不符，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The update doesn’t match the skill that was read; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 只能讀取這份內建技能列出的原始附件。
translations.en: Only the original attachments listed for this built-in skill can be read.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次技能協作已達回合或資料上限，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The session reached its round or data limit; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型等待已達本次時間上限，尚未儲存。
translations.en: Waiting for the model hit this session’s time limit; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法連線至設定的模型，尚未儲存。
translations.en: Couldn’t reach the configured model; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 設定的模型服務拒絕要求，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The configured model service refused the request; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回覆不完整或格式無效，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The model’s reply was incomplete or invalid; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消技能協作，尚未儲存。
translations.en: The skill session was cancelled; nothing was saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 技能草稿連續未通過檢查，尚未儲存；請調整要求後重新開始。
translations.en: The skill draft kept failing the checks; nothing was saved. Adjust your request and start again.

translations.zh-Hant: 幫我寫一則友善的訊息回覆
translations.en: Help me write a friendly reply to this message.

translations.zh-Hant: 在內建瀏覽器找一篇最近的 AI 新聞，摘要三個重點
translations.en: Find a recent AI news article in the built-in browser and summarize three key points.

translations.zh-Hant: 在 momo 購物找 1,000 元以內、4.5 星以上的無線耳機，比較三款的優缺點
translations.en: Find three wireless earbuds under NT$1,000 rated 4.5 stars or more on momo and compare their pros and cons.

translations.zh-Hant: 記住我偏好使用繁體中文，回答簡短一點
translations.en: Remember that I prefer concise answers in Traditional Chinese.
What preferences have I told you to remember?

translations.zh-Hant: 在 104 人力銀行搜尋台北的 AI 產品經理職缺，挑五個幫我比較
translations.en: Search 104 Job Bank for AI product manager jobs in Taipei and compare five of them for me.

translations.zh-Hant: 裝置是淺色就淺色，深色就深色
translations.en: Light or dark, whichever the device is in

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入完整的 HTTPS Base URL，不可包含帳密、查詢參數或片段。
translations.en: Enter a full HTTPS base URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.

translations.zh-Hant: 請填寫服務供應商提供的模型名稱。
translations.en: Enter the model name supplied by your service provider.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入 API Key。已有儲存的金鑰時，同一服務可留空沿用。
translations.en: Enter an API key. Leave it blank to reuse a saved key for the same service.

translations.zh-Hant: 服務主機或連接埠已變更，請重新輸入該服務的 API Key；不會自動沿用舊金鑰。
translations.en: The service host or port changed. Enter its API key again; the old key is not reused automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: API Key 不可包含空白或控制字元。
translations.en: The API key must not contain whitespace or control characters.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法存取 Keychain，設定未變更。請解鎖裝置後再試。
translations.en: Keychain is unavailable. Settings were not changed. Unlock the device and retry.

translations.zh-Hant: Keychain 存取失敗（系統代碼 %1$@），設定未變更。
translations.en: Keychain access failed (system code %1$@). Settings were not changed.

translations.zh-Hant: 伺服器未宣告工具能力
translations.en: The server did not declare tool support

translations.zh-Hant: 連接外部 MCP 伺服器後，可選擇允許助理使用的工具，預設全部允許。伺服器須使用 HTTPS，存取權杖只保存在這台裝置。在對話裡打開「本次對話使用 MCP 工具」就會自動連線；模型會直接執行允許的工具，不會每次先問你，工具說明和結果會送給你設定的模型。
translations.en: Connect an external MCP server and choose which tools the assistant can use; all are allowed by default. The server must use HTTPS, and the access token stays on this device. Turn on “Use MCP tools in this chat” and the app connects by itself. The model runs allowed tools without asking each time, and tool descriptions and results go to the model you set up.

translations.zh-Hant: UI 測試隔離模式：不會發送 MCP 網路請求。
translations.en: Isolated UI test mode: no MCP network requests.

translations.zh-Hant: 端點已安全儲存；不顯示網址。
translations.en: Endpoint stored securely; its URL is hidden.

translations.zh-Hant: 完整 HTTPS MCP 端點
完整網址和存取權杖只存在這台裝置解鎖時可讀的 Keychain，不透過 iCloud 同步。存成另一個網址時，原本的權杖和工具選擇會一起清除。
translations.en: The complete URL and the access token are kept only in this device’s Keychain, readable while it is unlocked, and never sync through iCloud. Saving a different URL also clears the old token and tool choices.

translations.zh-Hant: 已儲存存取權杖；不顯示內容。
translations.en: An access token is saved; it isn’t shown.

translations.zh-Hant: 移除此裝置儲存的 MCP 端點、存取權杖和工具選擇？
translations.en: Remove the MCP endpoint, access token and tool choices saved on this device?

translations.zh-Hant: 端點已儲存，尚未驗證連線
正在建立 MCP 工作階段…
正在擷取工具與資源目錄…
MCP 設定或連線未完成
translations.en: MCP setup or connection did not complete

translations.zh-Hant: 已暫停連線；回到 App 時會自動重新連線
translations.en: Paused; reconnects when you return to the app

translations.zh-Hant: 每次對話最多 64 個工具、說明合計 128 KB，格式不符的工具不能使用；超出的工具維持關閉。
translations.en: A chat can use at most 64 tools, with up to 128 KB of tool descriptions and no malformed tool; the rest stay off.

translations.zh-Hant: 已存入此裝置的 Keychain；尚未送出連線請求。
translations.en: Saved in this device’s Keychain; no connection request has been sent.

translations.zh-Hant: 已移除此 App 的 MCP 端點、存取權杖和工具選擇。
translations.en: This app’s MCP endpoint, access token and tool choices were removed.

translations.zh-Hant: 僅完成握手與目錄探索，未執行工具或讀取資源內容；不代表服務持續在線。
translations.en: Only the handshake and catalog discovery completed. No tool ran or resource content was read. This does not guarantee ongoing service availability.

translations.zh-Hant: MCP 連線或目錄擷取失敗。請檢查端點、存取權杖、網路及伺服器的 Streamable HTTP 支援；不會自動重試。
translations.en: MCP connection or catalog retrieval failed. Check the endpoint, access token, network and server’s Streamable HTTP support. There is no automatic retry.

translations.zh-Hant: 探索超過 90 秒，已停止本機等待；伺服器可能已收到目錄請求。
translations.en: Discovery exceeded 90 seconds. Local waiting stopped; the server may have received catalog requests.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消本機等待；伺服器可能已收到目錄請求。
translations.en: Local waiting cancelled; the server may have received catalog requests.

translations.zh-Hant: 已中斷連線並清除目錄；端點、存取權杖和工具選擇保留。未要求伺服器撤銷憑證或刪除遠端工作階段。
translations.en: Disconnected and catalogs cleared; the endpoint, access token and tool choices are kept. The server was not asked to revoke credentials or delete its session.

translations.zh-Hant: MCP 設定存取失敗；不會顯示端點或原始錯誤內容。
translations.en: MCP settings could not be accessed. The endpoint and original error are hidden.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入完整 HTTPS MCP 端點，不可含帳密、片段或空白。查詢參數會與整個端點一起安全儲存。
translations.en: Enter a complete HTTPS MCP endpoint without URL credentials, fragments or whitespace. Query parameters are stored securely with the endpoint.

translations.zh-Hant: 存取權杖要是一行、不含空白的英數字與符號，最長 8 KB。
translations.en: The access token must be one line of letters, digits and symbols with no spaces, at most 8 KB.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法存取 MCP Keychain，請解鎖裝置後再試。
translations.en: MCP Keychain is unavailable. Unlock the device and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: UI 測試缺少有效的隔離命名空間；不會讀取正式設定。
translations.en: The UI test has no valid isolated namespace. Production settings will not be read.

translations.zh-Hant: Live MCP UI 測試設定未完成，未取得私密端點。
translations.en: Live MCP UI test setup is incomplete; no private endpoint was obtained.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次 MCP 工具結果
MCP Keychain 存取失敗（系統代碼 %1$@）。

zh-Hant.other: 已選取 %lld 個工具供對話使用

translations.zh-Hant: 以 %%s 代表搜尋文字，只接受公開 HTTPS；不接受網址帳密、登入參數或 #。最多 20 個。
translations.en: Use %%s for search text. Only public HTTPS is accepted; no URL credentials, login parameters or #. Limit: 20 engines.

translations.zh-Hant: 變更引擎會用於下一次手動搜尋；目前頁面不會重新載入。搜尋結果網址會沿用瀏覽歷史的儲存與清除設定。
translations.en: Changes apply to your next manual search without reloading this page. Search result URLs follow your browsing history storage and clearing settings.

translations.zh-Hant: 瀏覽資料目前無法讀取，不會覆寫原有資料。
translations.en: Browsing data cannot be read. Existing data will not be overwritten.

translations.zh-Hant: 最多儲存 20 個自訂搜尋引擎。
translations.en: You can save at most 20 custom search engines.

translations.zh-Hant: 請填寫名稱與公開 HTTPS 模板；在路徑或查詢值中使用一個 %%s，不可含網址帳密、登入參數或 #。
translations.en: Enter a name and a public HTTPS template with one %%s in its path or a query value. URL credentials, login parameters and # are not allowed.

translations.zh-Hant: 測試上傳頁面未能啟動。
translations.en: The test upload page could not start.

translations.zh-Hant: 測試登入頁面未能啟動。
translations.en: The test login page could not start.

translations.zh-Hant: 瀏覽資料目前無法儲存。
translations.en: Browsing data cannot currently be saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 最多開啟 20 個分頁，請先關閉不用的分頁。
translations.en: At most 20 tabs can be open. Close an unused tab first.

translations.zh-Hant: 瀏覽資料未變更，請解鎖裝置後重試。
translations.en: Browsing data was not changed. Unlock the device and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 網頁尚未完全停止，網站資料未清除；請重試。
translations.en: Pages have not fully stopped. Site data was not cleared; please try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 部分網站資料仍保留，請重新確認。
translations.en: Some site data remains. Please check again.

translations.zh-Hant: 網站偏好已儲存，正在重新整理此頁以套用。
translations.en: Site preference saved; reloading this page to apply it.

translations.zh-Hant: 網站偏好已儲存；為避免重送表單或自動化操作，此頁不會重新整理，下次手動導覽時套用。
translations.en: Site preference saved. To avoid resubmitting forms or automated actions, this page will not reload. It will apply on your next manual navigation.

translations.zh-Hant: 清除瀏覽歷史？書籤與網站登入資料會保留。
translations.en: Clear browsing history? Bookmarks and site sign-in data will be kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 任務完成或需要核准時提醒你。通知只顯示固定提示；開啟後仍需在 App 內查看並決定。
translations.en: Get reminders when a task completes or needs approval. Notifications contain only fixed prompts. Open the app to review and decide.

translations.zh-Hant: 系統拒絕後，請到設定開啟通知。專注模式、通知摘要與靜音可能影響提示和聲音。
translations.en: If permission was denied, enable notifications in Settings. Focus, notification summaries and silent mode may affect alerts and sound.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法完成系統權限請求，請重新整理狀態後再試。
translations.en: The system permission request did not complete. Refresh the status and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 這次通知未能送出，請直接在 App 查看任務。
translations.en: This notification could not be sent. View the task in the app.

translations.zh-Hant: 開啟渥屋助理查看結果。
translations.en: Open woowtech agent to view the result.

translations.zh-Hant: 請開啟渥屋助理查看並決定；通知不會核准操作。
translations.en: Open woowtech agent to review and decide. Notifications do not approve actions.

translations.zh-Hant: 這是渥屋助理的測試通知。
translations.en: This is a test notification from woowtech agent.

translations.zh-Hant: 可請模型編寫並核准儲存；原版能力未完整支援
translations.en: Model-assisted authoring with reviewed saving; original capabilities are not fully supported

translations.zh-Hant: 只搜尋目前輸入，或開啟已儲存的最近網頁。
translations.en: Search what you typed, or open a saved recent page.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先開啟網站，再從書籤頁加入目前網頁。
translations.en: Open a website first, then add the current page from Bookmarks.

translations.zh-Hant: 關閉網頁並返回起始頁
translations.en: Close page and return to start

translations.zh-Hant: 此頁面仍受自動化導覽限制。
translations.en: This page is still restricted by automated navigation.

translations.zh-Hant: 問渥屋助理研究此網站
translations.en: Ask woowtech agent to research this site

translations.zh-Hant: 可手動登入網站及選取上傳檔案；網站資料保留於此 App。模型研究與每次核准的操作各自受限。
translations.en: You can sign in to sites and choose files to upload manually. Site data stays in this app. Model research and each approved action have separate limits.

translations.zh-Hant: 可安全重新整理的頁面會立即套用；其他頁面於下次手動導覽套用。
translations.en: Pages that can reload safely update now; other pages update on the next manual navigation.

translations.zh-Hant: 此頁無可分享的公開連結
translations.en: No public link to share on this page

translations.zh-Hant: 什麼時候彈出、去系統裡改
translations.en: When they pop up, change in system settings

translations.zh-Hant: 模型已就緒 · 可使用對話與內建瀏覽器
translations.en: Model ready · Chat and browser available

translations.zh-Hant: 新增一個支援工具呼叫的模型
translations.en: Add a model that supports tool calling

translations.zh-Hant: 會看不到任務結果和「需要你」提醒
translations.en: You won’t see task results or “Needs you” alerts

translations.zh-Hant: 「需要你處理」的通知不會彈出
要你同意時，這類通知現在只安靜地進通知中心，容易錯過。「任務結果」的通知也一樣。點「去開啟」，開啟「橫幅」。
translations.en: When you need to approve, these notifications now land quietly in Notification Center and are easy to miss. The same goes for “Task results”. Tap “Turn on” and turn on “Banners”.

translations.zh-Hant: 設定已儲存，尚未驗證連線。
translations.en: Settings saved. The connection has not been tested.

translations.zh-Hant: 新設定已儲存，尚未驗證連線。舊金鑰清理失敗，可用移除功能清除此 App 的模型金鑰。
translations.en: New settings saved; the connection has not been tested. The old key could not be removed. Use Remove to clear this app’s model keys.

translations.zh-Hant: 已移除此 App 的模型設定與金鑰；訊息草稿保留。
translations.en: This app’s model settings and key were removed; your message draft remains.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取或儲存模型設定，請移除設定後重新填寫。
translations.en: Could not read or save model settings. Remove the settings and enter them again.
Used while you hold to talk

translations.zh-Hant: API Key 只儲存在這台裝置上，加密存放。
translations.en: API keys are stored only on this device, encrypted.

translations.zh-Hant: 沒測試通過，任務可能會失敗
還沒有同意把內容傳給 %1$@；送出訊息前會先問你。
translations.en: You haven’t agreed to send your content to %1$@ yet; you’ll be asked before anything is sent.

translations.zh-Hant: 之前的模型設定讀不出來，沒有搬過來；請重新新增服務商。
translations.en: Your earlier model setting couldn’t be read and wasn’t carried over. Add a provider again.

translations.zh-Hant: 可不填，預設用網址的主機名

translations.en: Paste the key from your provider

translations.zh-Hant: 不需要 Key 的服務可不填
translations.en: Optional if the service needs no key

translations.zh-Hant: 介面網址要以 https:// 開頭；渥屋助理只用加密連線送出 Key 和對話。
translations.en: The base URL must start with https://; woowtech agent sends keys and chats only over encrypted connections.

translations.zh-Hant: 這是「%1$@」的官方網址，用它的預設更省事：網址和介面型別都已填好。
translations.en: This is %1$@’s official address. Its preset fills in the address and interface type for you.
the saved key couldn’t be read

translations.zh-Hant: 網址、模型名或 Key 的格式不對
translations.en: the address, model name or key isn’t valid

translations.zh-Hant: API Key 無效或沒有權限
translations.en: the API key is invalid or has no access

translations.zh-Hant: 找不到這個網址或模型
translations.en: the address or model wasn’t found

translations.zh-Hant: 請求太頻繁，請稍後再試
translations.en: too many requests; try again later

translations.zh-Hant: 服務商拒絕了這個請求
看不懂回傳的內容，請確認介面網址
translations.en: its reply couldn’t be read; check the base URL

translations.zh-Hant: 服務要求轉址；為了保護 Key 已停止
translations.en: the service asked to redirect, so the test stopped to protect the key
couldn’t connect to the model service

translations.zh-Hant: 渥屋助理會按你填的位址和 Key 存下這家服務商，不列模型、也不試呼叫。渥屋助理做事需要會呼叫工具的模型，沒測過的這一家可能連不通，也可能不會呼叫工具。存下之後可以在服務商頁「重新測試」。
translations.en: woowtech agent will save this provider with the address and key you entered, without listing models or making a test call. woowtech agent needs a model that can call tools to get things done, and an untested one may not connect or may not call tools. You can test it later from the provider’s page.

translations.zh-Hant: 已存下 %1$@，沒有測試過。它標著「沒測試過」；選一個模型時會先試呼叫，也可以在服務商頁「重新測試」。
translations.en: %1$@ was saved without a test. It’s marked as not tested; pick a model to check it, or test it again from the provider’s page.

translations.zh-Hant: 「測試並儲存」會用填的模型送出一句固定的測試訊息，有回覆才儲存；不會送出你的對話，但服務商可能收取少量費用。
translations.en: “Test and save” sends one fixed test message to the model you entered and saves only if it replies. Your chats aren’t sent, though the provider may charge a little.

translations.zh-Hant: 沒有儲存：要用 %1$@，需要先同意把內容傳給它。
translations.en: Not saved: to use %1$@, you need to agree to send your content to it first.

translations.zh-Hant: 思考和辦事都靠它。選支援工具呼叫的模型，辦事才靠得住。
translations.en: Does all the thinking and acting. Pick a model with tool calling so tasks go reliably.

translations.zh-Hant: 還沒有可選的模型。先新增一個服務商。
translations.en: No models to choose from yet. Add a provider first.

translations.zh-Hant: 這一版還不會向服務商要模型列表。在服務商下面填它說明文件裡的模型名，按「使用」會先試呼叫一次，通了才換。
translations.en: This version doesn’t ask providers for their model lists yet. Under a provider, enter a model name from its docs; “Use” makes one test call first and switches only if it works.

translations.zh-Hant: 點一個模型，可以把它用作主模型，或設定它能不能看圖。
translations.en: Tap a model to use it as the main model or say whether it can see images.

translations.zh-Hant: 這家是跳過測試存下的，還不知道能不能用。選一個模型時會先試呼叫，也可以點「重新測試」。
translations.en: This provider was saved without a test, so nothing is known about whether it works. Pick a model to test it, or tap “Test again”.

translations.zh-Hant: 這家的 API Key 會一起刪掉。
translations.en: Its API key will be deleted too.
%1$@ uses it; you’ll need to choose again after deleting.

translations.zh-Hant: 它沒在給任何用途幹活。
translations.en: It isn’t used for any role.

translations.zh-Hant: 已刪除「%1$@」和它的 API Key。
設定已儲存，但舊的 API Key 沒能刪掉；下次開啟 App 會再清一次。
translations.en: Saved, but the old API key couldn’t be deleted; the app tries again the next time it opens.

translations.zh-Hant: %1$@（%2$@）會收到下面這些內容，好讓它的模型回覆你：
translations.en: %1$@ (%2$@) will receive the following so its model can reply:

translations.zh-Hant: 你在對話裡輸入的文字
附件在這台裝置上讀出的文字（每個檔案最多 32 KB，一則訊息合計最多 64 KB）
translations.en: Text read from your attachments on this device (up to 32 KB per file and 64 KB per message)

translations.zh-Hant: 打開「能看圖」時，你附上的圖片
translations.en: Photos you attach, when “Can see images” is on

translations.zh-Hant: 跟對話一起送出的個人檔案
translations.en: Your profile, sent along with conversations

translations.zh-Hant: 研究網站或執行任務時讀到的網頁文字
translations.en: Text of web pages read during research and tasks

translations.zh-Hant: 研究網站時，請模型判斷結果的請求
translations.en: Requests during research that ask the model to judge the results

translations.zh-Hant: 你存的記憶：數量不多時全部附上，較多時附上和對話相關的部分
translations.en: Your saved memories: all of them when there are few, otherwise those relevant to the conversation

translations.zh-Hant: 技能清單（名稱和一句說明），以及相符或用到的技能全文
translations.en: Your skill list (names and one-line descriptions), and the full text of matching or used skills

translations.zh-Hant: 開啟「自動記住我說過的事」時，每次回覆後自動整理記憶的請求，含你說的話和相關的記憶
translations.en: With “Remember what I say automatically” on, the request after each reply that organizes your memories, with what you said and related memories

translations.zh-Hant: MCP 工具和資源回傳的結果
translations.en: Results from MCP tools and resources

translations.zh-Hant: %1$@ 是你自己選的第三方服務，會按它自己的條款和隱私權政策處理這些資料；渥屋助理不會把它們傳到其他地方。
translations.en: %1$@ is a third-party service you chose. It handles this data under its own terms and privacy policy; woowtech agent doesn’t send it anywhere else.

translations.zh-Hant: 不同意的話，什麼都不會傳出去，這家服務商也不會儲存。
translations.en: If you don’t agree, nothing is sent and this provider isn’t saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 不同意的話，什麼都不會傳出去，主模型維持不變。
translations.en: If you don’t agree, nothing is sent and the main model stays as it is.

translations.zh-Hant: 不同意的話，什麼都不會傳出去：這則訊息不會送出，草稿會保留。
translations.en: If you don’t agree, nothing is sent: this message stays unsent and your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 之後改用別家服務商的模型時，會再問你一次。
translations.en: You’ll be asked again before a model from another provider is used.

translations.zh-Hant: 沒有送出：你沒有同意把內容傳給 %1$@。草稿已保留。
translations.en: Not sent: you didn’t agree to send your content to %1$@. Your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 服務商已達上限，請先刪除不用的服務商。
translations.en: You’ve reached the provider limit. Delete one you don’t use first.

translations.zh-Hant: 還沒有同意把內容傳給這家服務商，設定未變更。
translations.en: You haven’t agreed to send your content to this provider; nothing was changed.

translations.zh-Hant: 僅顯示此裝置已加密保存的完整問答。
translations.en: Only completed exchanges in this device’s encrypted archive appear here.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取加密對話；原檔保留，請解鎖後重新讀取。
translations.en: Could not read the encrypted archive. The original file is retained; unlock and reload.

translations.zh-Hant: 釘選變更未保存；對話維持原狀。請重新開啟再試。
translations.en: The pin change was not saved. The conversation is unchanged; reopen it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入非空白的單行標題，且不要過長。
translations.en: Enter a nonempty, single-line title that is not too long.

translations.zh-Hant: 改名未保存；對話內容不變。請重新開啟再試。
translations.en: The new title was not saved. The conversation is unchanged; reopen it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 任務進行中，請先返回處理。
translations.en: A task is running. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 草稿或 PDF 附件未送出，請先返回處理。
translations.en: An unsent draft or PDF attachment is present. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 目前答覆尚未保存，請先返回處理。
translations.en: The current reply has not been saved. Return to the chat first.

translations.zh-Hant: 這段對話用的是別的模型服務或金鑰，目前無法在這裡開啟。
translations.en: This conversation used a different model service or key, so it can’t be opened here.

translations.zh-Hant: 選取的 PDF 尚未送出；開啟新對話會移除附件。
translations.en: The selected PDF has not been sent. Starting a new conversation removes the attachment.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次回覆尚未保存；開啟新對話會清除畫面中的回覆，並放棄重試保存。
translations.en: This reply has not been saved. Starting a new conversation clears the reply and gives up the save retry.

translations.zh-Hant: 未完成的回覆片段尚未保存；開啟新對話會清除它。
translations.en: The unfinished reply preview has not been saved. Starting a new conversation clears it.

translations.zh-Hant: 已有的純文字草稿會保留。
translations.en: Your unsent text draft will remain.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在使用 MCP 處理對話…
請先到設定填寫模型服務與 API Key。
translations.en: Set up a model service and API key in Settings first.

translations.zh-Hant: 還缺:還沒有能用的模型
UI 測試模式：固定回覆，不會呼叫網路。
translations.en: UI test mode: fixed replies; no network calls.

translations.zh-Hant: 只搜尋本次選取並核准擷取的頁面；沒有 OCR，也不傳送資料。
translations.en: Searches only the pages selected and approved for this extraction. No OCR or data transmission.

translations.zh-Hant: 不區分英文字母大小寫（A–Z）
支援文字、.、\d、\w、\s、字元類別如 [A-Z0-9] 或 [^0-9]、+、*、固定次數 {n}（1–16）及跳脫符號；例：[A-Z]+。只列非空匹配，不支援 ?、群組、或跨行。
translations.en: Use text, ., \d, \w, \s, classes such as [A-Z0-9] or [^0-9], +, *, {n} exact repeats (1–16), and escaped symbols; e.g. [A-Z]+. Empty matches are omitted. No ?, groups, alternation, or cross-line matches.

translations.zh-Hant: 正規表示式為空或格式無效，請檢查後重試。
translations.en: The pattern is empty or malformed. Check it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 此寫法尚未支援；請使用上方列出的有限語法。
translations.en: This syntax is not supported. Use the limited syntax listed above.

translations.zh-Hant: 搜尋已達上限而停止。若單頁過長，請改用字面搜尋；否則可縮小頁數或簡化條件。沒有顯示不完整結果。
translations.en: Search reached a limit. For an oversized single page, use literal search; otherwise select fewer pages or simplify the pattern. Partial results are not shown.

translations.zh-Hant: 輸入文字，最多 256 UTF-8 位元組
translations.en: Enter text, up to 256 UTF-8 bytes

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入 1–256 UTF-8 位元組的非空白搜尋文字，不能包含控制字元。
translations.en: Enter 1–256 UTF-8 bytes of nonblank search text without control characters.
Search did not finish. Try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次擷取頁面沒有符合的文字。
translations.en: No matches in the extracted pages.

translations.zh-Hant: 找到 %1$lld 處；還有其他符合位置。
這次擷取結果無法建立搜尋快照，請確認已擷取可讀取的文字。
translations.en: Could not create a search snapshot. Make sure readable text was extracted.

translations.zh-Hant: 按住說話，上滑取消，放開加入草稿。VoiceOver 可啟動開始及結束，或選擇取消語音輸入動作。
translations.en: Hold to speak, slide up to cancel, release to add to draft. With VoiceOver, activate to start and stop, or choose the cancel voice input action.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在聆聽，放開加入草稿；上滑取消
translations.en: Listening. Release to add to draft; slide up to cancel.

translations.zh-Hant: 未聽清楚，請按住說話再試一次。
translations.en: No speech recognized. Hold and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 麥克風權限已關閉，請至設定開啟後再試。
translations.en: Microphone access is off. Enable it in Settings and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 語音辨識權限已關閉，請至設定開啟後再試。
translations.en: Speech recognition access is off. Enable it in Settings and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 此裝置的語音辨識受到限制，請檢查裝置限制。
translations.en: Speech recognition is restricted on this device. Check device restrictions.

translations.zh-Hant: 目前無法使用裝置上語音辨識，請使用鍵盤；服務商語音轉文字尚未支援。
translations.en: On-device speech recognition is unavailable. Use the keyboard; provider transcription is not yet supported.

translations.zh-Hant: 音訊無法使用或已中斷，請檢查麥克風及音訊裝置後再試。
translations.en: Audio is unavailable or was interrupted. Check your microphone and audio route, then try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 語音辨識逾時，請再試一次。
translations.en: Speech recognition timed out. Please try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 語音輸入已中斷；如果剛完成授權，請再次按住說話。
translations.en: Voice input was interrupted. If you just granted access, hold to speak again.

translations.zh-Hant: 邊說邊出字；離線辨識需支援目前語言並具備語言包
translations.en: Shows words as you speak; offline recognition requires a supported language pack

translations.zh-Hant: 這台裝置沒有可用的語音辨識
translations.en: This device has no usable speech recognition
The text box can’t be held to talk
Choose on-device recognition or turn it off

translations.zh-Hant: 語音輸入已關閉或選項不可用；請在模型設定的「語音轉文字」中選擇。
translations.en: Voice input is off or the choice is unavailable. Choose an option in model settings under Speech to text.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法儲存語音設定，請再試一次。
translations.en: Could not save the voice setting. Try again.
This attachment is no longer available
Up to %1$lld attachments at a time

translations.zh-Hant: 一次最多 %1$lld 個附件,另外 %2$lld 個沒加上
translations.en: Up to %1$lld attachments at a time; %2$lld more were not added

translations.zh-Hant: 沒能新增:%1$@(單個檔案不超過 200 MB)
translations.en: Couldn’t add: %1$@ (each file must be 200 MB or less)

translations.zh-Hant: 未確認:它能看圖就打開,聊天附上的圖片會直接交給它看。
translations.en: Not confirmed: turn this on if it can see images, and photos attached in chat go straight to it.

translations.zh-Hant: 按你的設定。打開時,聊天附上的圖片會直接交給主模型看。
translations.en: As you set it. When on, photos attached in chat go straight to the main model.

zh-Hant.other: 這個模型不能看圖,%lld 張圖片沒有交給模型。可到設定的模型頁打開「能看圖」。

en.one: This model can’t see images, so %lld image wasn’t sent to it. Turn on Sees images on the model settings page.
en.other: This model can’t see images, so %lld images weren’t sent to it. Turn on Sees images on the model settings page.

translations.en: Press and hold the text to select it
Re-add the attachments you want to include

translations.zh-Hant: 檢舉內容會傳送給開發者。伺服器確認收到前，會保留在這台裝置上等待傳送。
translations.en: Your report will be sent to the developer. It remains pending on this device until the server confirms receipt.
Couldn’t save the report. Try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取已儲存的檢舉，請重試。
translations.en: Couldn’t check the saved report. Try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法確認先前的檢舉是否屬於這則回覆。新建檢舉可能與已收到的檢舉重複，舊紀錄會保留。是否繼續？
translations.en: An older report cannot be linked to this response with certainty. Creating a new report may duplicate one already received. Older reports will be kept. Continue?

translations.zh-Hant: 有一份舊檢舉無法讀取，也無法確認屬於哪則回覆。繼續可能重複傳送開發者已收到的檢舉。要繼續處理這則回覆嗎？
translations.en: An older report cannot be read or linked to a response. Continuing could send a report the developer has already received. Continue with this response?

translations.zh-Hant: 你已選擇繼續。無法讀取的紀錄存在期間，其他檢舉不會自動傳送。
translations.en: You chose to continue. While an unreadable record remains, other reports will not be sent automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: 舊檢舉尚未確認送達，也可能已經收到。新檢舉會使用新編號和目前時間，可能重複；舊紀錄會保留。是否繼續？
translations.en: The old report was not confirmed and may already have been received. A new report uses a new reference and date and could be a duplicate. The old report will be kept. Continue?

translations.zh-Hant: 這份新檢舉只會在你按下送出或重試時傳送，可能相關的舊檢舉不會自動重送。
translations.en: This new report is sent only when you submit or retry it here. Possibly related older reports will not be resent automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: 以下檢舉來自本對話，可能屬於其他回覆。請選取前核對回覆內容與編號。
translations.en: These reports are from this conversation and may concern other responses. Check the response and reference before selecting one.

translations.zh-Hant: 已選取本機檢舉；下方顯示當時的回覆。
translations.en: Selected local report; its original response is shown below.

translations.zh-Hant: 已有內容不同的新檢舉，請在重試前先核對下方內容。
translations.en: A new report already exists with different details. Review it below before retrying.
Delivery has not been confirmed. Reference: %1$@

translations.zh-Hant: 尚未確認送達。伺服器只接受建立時間在七天內的檢舉，請檢查裝置日期與時間。編號：%1$@
translations.en: Delivery has not been confirmed. The server accepts reports dated within seven days. Check your device’s date and time. Reference: %1$@

translations.zh-Hant: 已送達的檢舉會從開發者伺服器和本機刪除；未傳送的檢舉會從本機刪除。如果無法確認送達，檢舉會保留。
translations.en: A received report will be deleted from the developer’s server and this device. An unsent report will be removed from this device. If delivery cannot be verified, the report will be kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法確認刪除，檢舉已保留。請稍後重試。
translations.en: Deletion could not be confirmed. The report was kept; try again later.

translations.zh-Hant: 這份檢舉可能已送達，但沒有有效的刪除憑證，因此已保留。請依隱私權政策聯絡開發者並提供檢舉編號。
translations.en: This report may have reached the developer, but it has no valid deletion receipt. It was kept. Contact the developer using the privacy policy and include the report reference.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：API Key 無效或沒有權限。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the API key is invalid or has no access. Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：額度已用完。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the account has run out of credit. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：請求太頻繁，請稍後再試。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: too many requests; try again later. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：服務商那裡沒有這個模型。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the provider has no such model. Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：網路連線失敗。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: couldn’t connect to the model service. Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：回覆還沒傳完，連線就中斷了。請稍後再試。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the connection dropped before the reply finished. Try again later. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：看不懂回傳的內容，請確認介面網址和介面類型是否相符。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: its reply couldn’t be read; check that the base URL and API type match. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：伺服器端出錯（HTTP %1$lld）。請稍後再試。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the server returned an error (HTTP %1$lld). Try again later. Your draft is preserved.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗：伺服器端出錯（HTTP %1$lld）。請到設定 › 模型檢查。草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model call failed: the server returned an error (HTTP %1$lld). Check Settings › Models. Your draft is preserved.
“%1$@” and the files in it will be deleted.

translations.zh-Hant: 已暫停：回到渥屋助理就會繼續
translations.en: Paused. It continues when you return to woowtech agent.

translations.zh-Hant: 讀完這頁，稍等一下再開 %1$@ 的下一頁
translations.en: Pausing before the next page of %1$@

translations.zh-Hant: 在 App 開著時進行。點小畫面可以放大看，離開 App 會暫停。
translations.en: Runs while the app is open. Tap the small view to enlarge it; leaving the app pauses it.

translations.zh-Hant: 網頁任務：%1$@，第 %2$lld 步，已進行 %3$@
一直重複同樣的步驟，所以先停下來。
translations.en: It kept repeating the same step, so it stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 連續好幾步都沒成功，所以先停下來。
translations.en: Several steps in a row failed, so it stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型沒有給出可用的下一步，所以先停下來。
translations.en: The model didn’t give a usable next step, so it stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 呼叫模型失敗，網頁任務停在這裡。請檢查模型設定或網路後再試一次。
translations.en: The model call failed, so the web task stopped here. Check the model settings or the network and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 你在對話中請渥屋助理上網時，它會在 App 的內建瀏覽器自動開啟網站、讀取網頁，也可以替你點選、輸入和送出表單；網址、標題、網頁文字和按鈕、欄位的名稱會傳給你選的模型服務。花錢的步驟每次都要你同意，付款一律由你自己完成。任務分頁和內建瀏覽器共用網站資料，所以可能讀到你在 App 內登入的網站內容。截圖、Cookie、密碼和你在欄位裡填的內容都不會傳送。
translations.en: When you ask woowtech agent to use the web in a chat, it opens websites in the app’s built-in browser, reads them, and can tap, type and send forms for you; page addresses, titles, text and the names of buttons and fields go to the model service you chose. Anything that spends money needs your OK every time, and you always pay yourself. The task tab shares website data with the built-in browser, so it may read sites you signed in to in the app. Screenshots, cookies, passwords and what you type into fields are not sent.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在 %1$@ 的網頁上操作
花錢的操作每次都要你同意。
translations.en: Anything that spends money needs your OK every time.
woowtech agent is waiting for you: %1$@

translations.zh-Hant: 網頁在你手上；處理好後按「處理好了」。
translations.en: You have the page. Tap Done when you’re finished.

translations.zh-Hant: 回到渥屋助理就會繼續。
translations.en: It continues when you return to woowtech agent.

translations.zh-Hant: 請開啟渥屋助理查看；通知不會核准操作。
translations.en: Open woowtech agent to see it; a notification never approves anything.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆產生中・尚未完成，未保存
translations.en: Reply in progress · not finished, not saved

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消・部分回覆未保存
回覆未完成・部分回覆未保存
translations.en: Reply not finished · partial reply not saved

translations.zh-Hant: 這段對話使用的模型設定已變更；請開新對話後再傳送，草稿已保留。
translations.en: The model settings this chat used have changed. Start a new chat to send; your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 已開啟保存的對話；尚未傳送任何訊息。
translations.en: Opened a saved chat. Nothing has been sent yet.

translations.zh-Hant: 回覆已顯示，但本次對話未能保存；關閉程序後可能遺失。原有保存內容保留，沒有自動刪除舊對話。
translations.en: The reply is shown, but this chat couldn’t be saved and may be lost when the app closes. Earlier saved content is kept; no old chat was deleted.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先傳送或移除引用，再變更模型設定。
translations.en: Send or remove the quote before changing model settings.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先傳送或移除引用，再移除模型設定。
translations.en: Send or remove the quote before removing model settings.

translations.zh-Hant: 引用來源已變更；草稿與引用保留，請重新選取。
translations.en: The quoted message changed. Your draft and quote are kept; select it again.

translations.zh-Hant: 原對話已變更或尚未保存；草稿保留，請先確認保存狀態。
translations.en: The original chat changed or isn’t saved yet. Your draft is kept; check that it’s saved first.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先在 MCP 伺服器頁儲存端點並保留至少一個工具，或關閉對話的 MCP 選項；草稿已保留。
translations.en: Save an endpoint and keep at least one tool on the MCP servers page, or turn off MCP for this chat. Your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: MCP 伺服器連不上，草稿已保留。請到 MCP 伺服器頁確認網址和存取權杖後再試。
translations.en: The MCP server couldn’t be reached. Your draft is kept. Check its URL and access token on the MCP servers page, then try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取金鑰，草稿已保留。請在設定確認或重新儲存金鑰。
translations.en: Couldn’t read the key; your draft is kept. Check or save the key again in Settings.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法讀取學習資料，請重新讀取後再試。
translations.en: Couldn’t read learning data. Reload it and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回傳空白內容，草稿已保留，請重試。
translations.en: The model returned an empty reply. Your draft is kept; try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型仍未提供可用的單一步驟指令，已停止；草稿與先前工具結果保留。
translations.en: The model still didn’t give a usable single-step command, so it stopped. Your draft and earlier tool results are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 傳送失敗，草稿已保留。請檢查模型設定或網路後重試。
translations.en: Couldn’t send; your draft is kept. Check the model settings or network and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: MCP 對話未完成，草稿與已收到的工具結果保留；請先確認已送出操作，不會自動重試。
translations.en: The MCP chat didn’t finish. Your draft and the tool results received are kept. Check any actions already sent; nothing is retried automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: 記憶修改已儲存，但後續模型回覆未完成；請先查看保存結果或撤銷，避免重複修改。草稿保留。
translations.en: The memory change was saved, but the model’s reply didn’t finish. Check the saved result or undo it so it isn’t changed twice. Your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 個人檔案已儲存，但後續模型回覆未完成；草稿保留。
translations.en: The profile was saved, but the model’s reply didn’t finish. Your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務拒絕驗證，請檢查模型金鑰與存取權限。
translations.en: The model service rejected authentication. Check the model key and access.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務目前限制請求，請稍後再試。
translations.en: The model service is limiting requests. Try again later.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務暫時無法處理請求，請稍後再試。
translations.en: The model service can’t handle requests right now. Try again later.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務拒絕這次請求，請檢查服務與模型設定。
translations.en: The model service refused this request. Check the service and model settings.
Timed out waiting for the model’s reply.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法連線至模型服務，請檢查網路。
translations.en: Couldn’t reach the model service. Check the network.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次對話未啟用記憶與個人檔案工具，修改要求已停止。
translations.en: Memory and profile tools aren’t on for this chat, so the change request stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 這次記憶工具操作已失效，修改要求已停止。
translations.en: This memory tool action expired, so the change request stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 本機記憶工具未傳回完整結果，對話已停止。
translations.en: The on-device memory tool didn’t return a complete result, so the chat stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消等待，草稿已保留。伺服器可能已收到請求。
translations.en: Stopped waiting; your draft is kept. The server may already have received the request.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料正在其他位置儲存；本次修改未儲存，草稿保留。請稍後重新確認。
translations.en: Learning data is being saved elsewhere, so this change wasn’t saved. Your draft is kept; check again shortly.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料已變更；本次對話已停止，草稿保留。請重新讀取資料並再次確認。
translations.en: Learning data changed, so this chat stopped. Your draft is kept; reload the data and check again.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料無法儲存，這次修改未發布；原有資料與草稿保留，請確認裝置儲存狀態後再試。
translations.en: Learning data couldn’t be saved, so this change wasn’t applied. Your existing data and draft are kept; check the device’s storage and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 記憶工具未通過來源、目標或資料狀態檢查，已停止；草稿保留。已完成的儲存會另外顯示。
translations.en: The memory tool failed its source, target or data check and stopped. Your draft is kept; finished saves are shown separately.

translations.zh-Hant: 個人檔案工具未通過檢查或已超過執行限制，已停止；草稿保留。已完成的儲存會另外顯示。
translations.en: The profile tool failed its checks or hit its limit and stopped. Your draft is kept; finished saves are shown separately.

translations.zh-Hant: 已開啟新對話；已確認的記憶與技能保留。
translations.en: Started a new chat. Your confirmed memories and skills are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 你已拒絕這次呼叫，MCP 對話已停止；草稿與先前工具結果保留。
translations.en: You declined this call, so the MCP chat stopped. Your draft and earlier tool results are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 工具回報錯誤，已停止；請檢視工具結果。草稿保留，不會自動重試。
translations.en: A tool reported an error, so it stopped. Review the tool results. Your draft is kept; nothing is retried automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次對話的記憶搜尋或修改額度已用完，已停止；草稿與先前結果保留。
translations.en: This chat used up its memory search or change allowance, so it stopped. Your draft and earlier results are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 已達 MCP 執行限制或偵測到重複呼叫；草稿與已收到的工具結果保留。
translations.en: Reached the MCP run limit or detected repeated calls. Your draft and the tool results received are kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 聊天歷史不是完整的使用者與助理回合，請開啟新對話後再試。
translations.en: The chat history isn’t made of complete user and assistant turns. Start a new chat and try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 這次訊息與參考內容超過傳送上限，請縮短訊息或參考內容。
translations.en: This message and its references are over the sending limit. Shorten the message or the references.

translations.zh-Hant: 無法準備本次參考資料，尚未開始研究。
translations.en: Couldn’t prepare the references for this run; research hasn’t started.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次參考資料已撤銷，研究已停止；請確認目前設定後重新開始。
translations.en: This run’s references were withdrawn, so research stopped. Check the current settings and start again.

translations.zh-Hant: 學習資料正在使用中；請稍後重新開始。
translations.en: Learning data is in use. Start again shortly.

translations.zh-Hant: 目前模型連線無法確認請求生命週期；尚未送出參考資料。
translations.en: The current model connection can’t confirm the request’s lifecycle; the references weren’t sent.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先讀取這個網頁的控制項。
頁面或控制項已變更；沒有執行，請重新讀取並核准。
translations.en: The page or its controls changed; nothing ran. Read them again and approve.

translations.zh-Hant: 這個控制項不可操作或屬於受保護欄位。
translations.en: This control can’t be used or is a protected field.

translations.zh-Hant: 動作格式無法辨識；沒有執行。
translations.en: The action’s format wasn’t recognized; nothing ran.

translations.zh-Hant: 動作目的地不在允許的公開 HTTPS 範圍。
translations.en: The action’s destination is outside the allowed public HTTPS sites.

translations.zh-Hant: 這個動作尚未取得單次核准，或核准已用過。
translations.en: This action isn’t approved yet, or its approval was already used.

translations.zh-Hant: 核准要求已逾時；請重新讀取並提出動作。
translations.en: The approval request expired. Read the controls again and propose the action.

translations.zh-Hant: 請先停止目前的研究或網頁操作。
translations.en: Stop the current research or page action first.

translations.zh-Hant: 網頁動作未確認完成；不會自動重試。
translations.en: The page action wasn’t confirmed as done; it won’t be retried.

translations.zh-Hant: 網頁回應逾時；動作可能已送出，請先確認頁面，不會重試。
translations.en: The page timed out. The action may have been sent, so check the page first; it won’t be retried.

translations.zh-Hant: 研究目標或模型指令的參數不完整，已停止研究。
translations.en: The research goal or the model’s command was incomplete, so research stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回傳的研究指令格式無法辨識，已停止研究。
translations.en: The model’s research command wasn’t recognized, so research stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型要求不支援的研究操作；未執行該操作。
translations.en: The model asked for an unsupported research step; it wasn’t run.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型選取的連結不在目前頁面的可用清單內；未開啟該連結。
translations.en: The link the model chose isn’t on this page’s list; it wasn’t opened.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回傳的研究指令超過大小限制，已停止研究。
translations.en: The model’s research command was too large, so research stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 目前頁面無法讀取；請確認頁面已載入。
translations.en: This page can’t be read. Make sure it has loaded.

translations.zh-Hant: 此導覽不在目前允許的公開網站範圍內，已停止研究。
translations.en: This navigation is outside the allowed public sites, so research stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 讀取時頁面已變更或內容格式無法辨識，已停止研究。
translations.en: The page changed while it was read, or its content wasn’t recognized, so research stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 網頁導覽失敗或被瀏覽器阻擋；未當成已完成的讀取。
translations.en: Navigation failed or the browser blocked it; it doesn’t count as a completed read.

translations.zh-Hant: 等待網頁載入超過時間限制，已停止研究。
translations.en: The page took too long to load, so research stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 讀取網頁內容超過時間限制，已停止研究。
translations.en: Reading the page took too long, so research stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 網站研究超過整體時間限制，已停止研究。
translations.en: Website research went over its time limit and stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型設定不完整；請檢查服務、模型與金鑰設定。
translations.en: Model settings are incomplete. Check the service, model and key.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務要求重新導向，已基於安全限制拒絕。
translations.en: The model service asked to redirect, which was refused for safety.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務回報無效的 HTTP 狀態，研究未完成。
translations.en: The model service returned an invalid HTTP status; research didn’t finish.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務回應格式無法辨識，研究未完成。
translations.en: The model service’s response wasn’t recognized; research didn’t finish.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型回應未完整結束，研究未完成。
translations.en: The model’s response ended early; research didn’t finish.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務回應超過大小限制，研究未完成。
translations.en: The model service’s response was too large; research didn’t finish.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型輸出超過處理緩衝限制，研究未完成。
translations.en: The model’s output overflowed the processing buffer; research didn’t finish.

translations.zh-Hant: 等待模型服務超過時間限制，研究未完成。
translations.en: The model service took too long; research didn’t finish.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務連線失敗，研究未完成；請檢查網路與服務設定。
translations.en: Couldn’t connect to the model service; research didn’t finish. Check the network and service settings.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次參考資料已撤銷，研究已停止；已讀取內容保留。
translations.en: This run’s references were withdrawn, so research stopped. What was read is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 研究已取消；已讀取內容保留。
translations.en: Research cancelled. What was read is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面或模型請求未完成；已讀取內容保留，未產生已驗證的技能。
translations.en: The page or model request didn’t finish. What was read is kept; no verified skill was made.

translations.zh-Hant: 已停止研究：達到步數上限或遇到重複操作。已讀取的頁面保留在操作紀錄，尚未確認任務完成。
translations.en: Research stopped: it reached the step limit or repeated an action. The pages read stay in the log; the task isn’t confirmed as done.
Enter an address to start browsing

translations.zh-Hant: 讀取控制項後，每個動作都需單次核准。
translations.en: After the controls are read, each action needs a one-time approval.

translations.zh-Hant: 請輸入搜尋文字或公開 HTTPS 網址；不接受本機網址、網址帳密或過長的查詢。
translations.en: Enter search text or a public HTTPS address. Local addresses, credentials in the address and very long queries aren’t accepted.

translations.zh-Hant: 已停止；已取得的內容與草稿保留
translations.en: Stopped; what was read and your draft are kept

translations.zh-Hant: 研究已停止，尚未確認完成
translations.en: Research stopped, not confirmed as done

translations.zh-Hant: 回答已交付，正在判定成果…
研究未完成；已讀取內容保留
translations.en: Research didn’t finish; what was read is kept

translations.zh-Hant: 請先到設定儲存模型服務與金鑰。
translations.en: Save a model service and key in Settings first.

translations.zh-Hant: 資料已變更，未套用這次學習。
translations.en: The data changed, so this learning wasn’t applied.

translations.zh-Hant: 回答已保留；學習資料未儲存，可能有更新或寫入失敗。
translations.en: The answer is kept; learning data wasn’t saved (it may have changed, or writing failed).

translations.zh-Hant: 已判定任務完成；未新增技能草稿。
translations.en: Judged done; no skill draft was added.

translations.zh-Hant: 已判定任務完成；技能草稿已加入待確認，核准後才能使用。
translations.en: Judged done; a skill draft is waiting for your approval before it can be used.

translations.zh-Hant: 判定只完成部分內容，未學習新的技能。
translations.en: Judged partly done; no new skill was learned.

translations.zh-Hant: 判定未達成要求，未學習新的技能。
translations.en: Judged not achieved; no new skill was learned.

translations.zh-Hant: 成果尚無法判定，未當成技能驗證成功。
translations.en: The result can’t be judged yet, so it doesn’t count as a verified skill.

translations.zh-Hant: 回答已保留；這次成果判定或學習未完成。
translations.en: The answer is kept; judging or learning didn’t finish this time.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在逐步核對網頁路線…
translations.en: Checking the saved route step by step…

translations.zh-Hant: 路線核對超過時間限制，已停止。
translations.en: Checking the route took too long and stopped.

translations.zh-Hant: 路線核對與成果判定完成；未重複產生技能。
translations.en: Route check and judging are done; no duplicate skill was made.

translations.zh-Hant: 成果已交付；路線結果未儲存。
translations.en: The result was delivered; the route result wasn’t saved.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面已核對，但原任務尚未確認完成；未增加成功次數。
translations.en: The pages were checked, but the original task isn’t confirmed as done, so the success count wasn’t raised.

translations.zh-Hant: 路線已停止；內容變更或請求未完成
translations.en: Route stopped; the content changed or a request didn’t finish

translations.zh-Hant: 路線或模型設定不可用，請先確認版本、網站與模型設定。
translations.en: The route or model settings aren’t available. Check the version, site and model settings first.

translations.zh-Hant: 等待單次核准；尚未操作網頁。
translations.en: Waiting for a one-time approval; the page hasn’t been touched.

translations.zh-Hant: 控制項已更新；網頁欄位值不會傳給模型。
translations.en: Controls updated; field values aren’t sent to the model.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型正在提出下一個動作，尚未執行…
translations.en: The model is proposing the next action; nothing has run…

translations.zh-Hant: 模型提案逾時；沒有核准或執行動作。
translations.en: The model’s proposal timed out; nothing was approved or run.

translations.zh-Hant: 正在執行這一個已核准動作…
已送出單次 DOM 動作；請確認網頁結果，不代表網站任務已成功。
translations.en: Sent one page action. Check the result on the page; this doesn’t mean the task succeeded.

translations.zh-Hant: 已取消；尚未核准的動作不會執行，已送出的動作無法撤回。
translations.en: Cancelled. Actions not yet approved won’t run; actions already sent can’t be undone.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面已重新整理；先前的提案已取消。
translations.en: The page reloaded; the earlier proposal was cancelled.

translations.zh-Hant: 請求未完成；沒有自動重試或核准其他動作。
translations.en: The request didn’t finish; nothing was retried or approved automatically.

translations.zh-Hant: 網站偏好已儲存；此頁無法安全重新整理，將於下次手動導覽套用。
translations.en: Site preference saved. This page can’t be reloaded safely, so it applies the next time you navigate.

translations.zh-Hant: 此導覽不在目前允許的公開網站範圍內。
translations.en: This navigation is outside the allowed public sites.

translations.zh-Hant: 瀏覽器裡暫時不能下載檔案。
translations.en: The browser can’t download files yet.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面已載入；此頁面僅供手動瀏覽
translations.en: Page loaded; this page is for manual browsing only

translations.zh-Hant: 網站載入失敗，請檢查網址或網路。
translations.en: The site didn’t load. Check the address or network.

translations.zh-Hant: 網頁程序已停止；請確認後重新開啟，沒有自動重試。
translations.en: The page’s process stopped. Check it and open it again; it wasn’t retried.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面已載入；此路由內容未能讀取
translations.en: Page loaded; this route’s content couldn’t be read

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面內容讀取未完成；沒有自動重試。
translations.en: Reading the page didn’t finish; it wasn’t retried.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面載入後的內容讀取未完成；沒有自動重試。
translations.en: Reading the page after it loaded didn’t finish; it wasn’t retried.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面載入未完成；請確認網址與網路。
translations.en: The page didn’t finish loading. Check the address and network.

translations.zh-Hant: 已讀內容超過本次模型輸入上限，請縮小研究範圍；實際讀取紀錄保留。
translations.en: What was read is over the model’s input limit for this run. Narrow the research; the reading log is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次傳送最近 %1$lld 輪對話、本輪完整訊息及參考資料；較早 %2$lld 輪仍在畫面中，但未傳送。
translations.en: Sent the last %1$lld turns, this full message and its references; %2$lld earlier turns stay on screen but weren’t sent.

translations.zh-Hant: 記憶修改已儲存，但後續回覆等待超過 %1$lld 秒；請先查看保存結果或撤銷。草稿保留。
translations.en: The memory change was saved, but the reply took more than %1$lld seconds. Check the saved result or undo it. Your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 等待超過 %1$lld 秒，已停止等待；草稿已保留，可重試。
translations.en: Stopped waiting after %1$lld seconds. Your draft is kept; you can try again.

translations.zh-Hant: 個人檔案已儲存，但後續回覆等待超過 %1$lld 秒；草稿保留。
translations.en: The profile was saved, but the reply took more than %1$lld seconds. Your draft is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: MCP 嘗試呼叫 %1$lld 次；已收到 %2$lld 次結果；工具錯誤 %3$lld 次。
translations.en: MCP calls tried: %1$lld; results received: %2$lld; tool errors: %3$lld.

translations.zh-Hant: 模型服務回報 HTTP %1$lld，研究未完成；請檢查服務與存取設定。
translations.en: The model service returned HTTP %1$lld; research didn’t finish. Check the service and access settings.

translations.zh-Hant: 草稿與已收到的工具結果保留；沒有自動重送操作。
translations.en: Your draft and the tool results received are kept; nothing was resent.

translations.zh-Hant: 沒有跳過內容核對，也未自動重新學習。已讀取內容保留。
translations.en: Content checks weren’t skipped and nothing was relearned automatically. What was read is kept.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次對話使用 MCP 工具
translations.en: Use MCP tools in this chat

translations.zh-Hant: 本次對話曾儲存個人檔案；可在資料頁用「全部清除」刪除。
translations.en: This chat saved to your profile. To delete it, use Clear all on the Memory & data page.

translations.zh-Hant: 本次對話曾儲存記憶修改；可在資料頁查看目前內容。
translations.en: This chat changed your memories. See the current content on the Memory & data page.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面標籤只是網站資料，不是你的指令。網頁事件可能提交資料或觸發其他效果；核准後無法保證撤回。
translations.en: Page labels are website data, not your instructions. Page events may submit data or have other effects; once approved, they can’t be guaranteed to be undone.

translations.zh-Hant: 這會取代整個欄位；目前欄位值不會讀取或帶給模型。
translations.en: This replaces the whole field. The field’s current value isn’t read or sent to the model.

translations.zh-Hant: 希望這個網頁完成什麼？
translations.en: What should this page get done?
Ask the model for the next step

translations.zh-Hant: 只傳送控制項標籤與選項，不含欄位值。模型提案不會自動執行，也不會自動學習為成功技能。
translations.en: Only control labels and options are sent, not field values. The model’s proposal doesn’t run by itself and isn’t learned as a successful skill.

translations.zh-Hant: 控制項數量達上限；未列出的項目不能由模型操作。
translations.en: Too many controls; the model can’t use ones that aren’t listed.

translations.zh-Hant: 頁面文字會傳送到你設定的模型服務。研究只讀取網頁與開啟同站連結。
translations.en: Page text is sent to the model service you set up. Research only reads pages and opens links on the same site.
